relationships.yudai-moroboshi: Bukyou teammate who brings him to Ikki's training.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Former tournament opponent; assists his final preparation.

periods.summary: Byakuya joins Moroboshi's group of defeated rivals who help Ikki tune himself before the final. He is among the first beaten in the gauntlet, but later observes the final and explains to Shizuku that Stella's self-stabbing motion against Ouma was a staged tell meant to deceive Ikki in the final.

key_events.summary: Analyzes Stella's cross-match Dragon Spirit deception.

periods.time: During a Bukyoku newspaper-club interview while Moroboshi spars in Tokyo
periods.label: 天眼对白诸星的杀手本能

status.current: interviewed by Bukyoku newspaper club after special conscription duty

relationships.yudai-moroboshi: Classmate and rival whom Byakuya considers more frightening than Ikki in some respects.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Opponent who beat him quickly under unusual tournament conditions.
relationships.momiji-asagi: One of Bukyoku's three student stars, mentioned as a more popular feature subject.

periods.summary: Byakuya is interviewed by Bukyoku newspaper-club president Yagokoro after Moroboshi unexpectedly goes to Tokyo. He says Ikki is strong, but Moroboshi is more frightening to him because Byakuya has fought Moroboshi countless times, knows him better than anyone, and still has never won. He describes Moroboshi's ability to exceed data and prediction at decisive moments as Killer Instinct, an observation that contextualizes Moroboshi's final aura against Kuraudo.

key_events.summary: Explains why Moroboshi can overturn even well-planned strategies.

periods.time: Emergency summons from Bukyoku Academy to Fukuoka
periods.label: 天眼的紧急传送
periods.affiliation: Bukyoku Academy; International Mage-Knight League emergency response

status.current: supports Wakaba House and refugee evacuation after teleporting Moroboshi to Kyushu

relationships.yudai-moroboshi: Teleports Moroboshi from Osaka to Kyushu under League summons.
relationships.kanata-tokutomiya: Meets her after arriving and remains near evacuation operations.
relationships.toka-todo: Indirectly helps rescue her by delivering Moroboshi.

periods.summary: Jounosaki is specially summoned along with Moroboshi because his Teleport can rapidly deliver Moroboshi to Fukuoka. He transports them from Osaka to Kyushu in roughly five minutes, meets Kanata, and then stays with the evacuation side because no one is better at escaping and moving people than he is. His role is logistical but crucial: without his teleportation Moroboshi would not arrive in time to save Toka and Misogi from Tendo's first close-range assault.

key_events.summary: Enables Moroboshi's timely arrival by teleporting him from Bukyoku to Kyushu.
